<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ============================================================
     DAFTAR DOMAIN RESMI LANDAKTOTO
     Isi dengan semua domain resmi (tanpa https:// dan tanpa garis miring).
     Subdomain otomatis ikut dianggap resmi. Contoh:
       officialDomains: ["landaktoto.org", "landaktoto.com"]
     Selama daftar kosong, pemeriksaan domain tampil kuning.
     ============================================================ */
  var CONFIG = { officialDomains: [] };

  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var box = $("rjbScan");
  if (!box) return;

  var host = (location.hostname || "").toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, "");
  $("rjbHost").textContent = host || "(file lokal)";

  function isOfficial(h) {
    return CONFIG.officialDomains.some(function (d) {
      d = String(d).toLowerCase().replace(/^https?:\/\//, "").replace(/^www\./, "").replace(/\/.*$/, "");
      return h === d || h.slice(-(d.length + 1)) === "." + d;
    });
  }
  function framed() { try { return window.top !== window.self; } catch (e) { return true; } }

  var CHECKS = [
    { name: "Koneksi HTTPS", run: function () {
        if (location.protocol === "https:") return ["ok", "Koneksi terenkripsi, data login tidak terbaca pihak lain."];
        if (location.protocol === "file:" || host === "localhost") return ["warn", "Halaman dibuka secara lokal (pratinjau)."];
        return ["bad", "Halaman tidak memakai HTTPS. Jangan masukkan data akun."];
      } },
    { name: "Domain resmi LANDAKTOTO", run: function () {
        if (!CONFIG.officialDomains.length) return ["warn", "Daftar domain resmi belum diatur oleh pengelola situs."];
        if (host && isOfficial(host)) return ["ok", "Alamat ini terdaftar sebagai domain resmi."];
        return ["bad", "Alamat ini tidak terdaftar sebagai domain resmi."];
      } },
    { name: "Tidak dibingkai situs lain", run: function () {
        return framed() ? ["warn", "Halaman tampil di dalam bingkai situs lain. Buka langsung dari bookmark."]
                        : ["ok", "Halaman dibuka langsung, bukan tiruan dalam bingkai."];
      } },
    { name: "Konteks aman browser", run: function () {
        return window.isSecureContext ? ["ok", "Browser menandai halaman ini sebagai konteks aman."]
                                      : ["warn", "Browser tidak menandai halaman ini sebagai konteks aman."];
      } },
    { name: "Fitur keamanan browser", run: function () {
        var modern = "fetch" in window && "Promise" in window && window.CSS && CSS.supports && CSS.supports("display", "grid");
        return modern ? ["ok", "Browser mendukung fitur keamanan modern."]
                      : ["warn", "Browser terlihat usang. Perbarui ke versi terbaru."];
      } }
  ];
  var LABEL = { ok: "Aman", warn: "Perhatian", bad: "Bahaya", run: "Memeriksa", idle: "Menunggu" };
  var ICON = { ok: "✓", warn: "!", bad: "✕", idle: "•", run: "" };

  var list = $("rjbChecks"), rows = [];
  CHECKS.forEach(function (c) {
    var li = document.createElement("li");
    li.className = "rjb-check"; li.setAttribute("data-s", "idle");
    li.innerHTML = '<i></i><div><b></b><span></span></div><em></em>';
    li.querySelector("b").textContent = c.name;
    li.querySelector("span").textContent = "Belum diperiksa.";
    li.querySelector("i").textContent = ICON.idle;
    li.querySelector("em").textContent = LABEL.idle;
    list.appendChild(li); rows.push(li);
  });

  function setRow(li, s, msg) {
    li.setAttribute("data-s", s);
    li.querySelector("i").textContent = ICON[s];
    li.querySelector("em").textContent = LABEL[s];
    if (msg) li.querySelector("span").textContent = msg;
  }
  function log(text, cls) {
    var d = document.createElement("div"), t = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("id-ID", { hour12: false });
    d.textContent = "[" + t + "] " + text; if (cls) d.className = cls;
    var el = $("rjbLog"); el.appendChild(d); el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
  }

  function run() {
    var btn = $("rjbRun"), ring = $("rjbRing"), verdict = $("rjbVerdict");
    btn.disabled = true; box.classList.add("is-running");
    verdict.setAttribute("data-s", ""); verdict.textContent = "Memeriksa…";
    $("rjbScore").textContent = "…"; ring.style.setProperty("--p", 0);
    rows.forEach(function (li) { setRow(li, "idle", "Menunggu giliran."); });
    log("Memulai pemeriksaan untuk " + (host || "file lokal"));

    var score = 0, worst = "ok", i = 0;
    (function next() {
      if (i >= CHECKS.length) {
        var pct = Math.round(score / (CHECKS.length * 2) * 100);
        $("rjbScore").textContent = pct;
        ring.style.setProperty("--p", pct);
        ring.style.setProperty("--c", worst === "bad" ? "var(--rjb-bad)" : worst === "warn" ? "var(--rjb-warn)" : "var(--rjb-ok)");
        verdict.setAttribute("data-s", worst);
        verdict.textContent = worst === "ok" ? "Halaman aman" : worst === "warn" ? "Perlu perhatian" : "Jangan login di sini";
        log("Selesai. Skor " + pct + "/100", worst);
        box.classList.remove("is-running"); btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Periksa Ulang";
        return;
      }
      var li = rows[i], c = CHECKS[i];
      setRow(li, "run", "Sedang memeriksa…");
      setTimeout(function () {
        var r = c.run(); setRow(li, r[0], r[1]);
        score += r[0] === "ok" ? 2 : r[0] === "warn" ? 1 : 0;
        if (r[0] === "bad" || (r[0] === "warn" && worst === "ok")) worst = r[0];
        log(c.name + ": " + LABEL[r[0]], r[0]);
        i++; next();
      }, 520);
    })();
  }

  $("rjbRun").addEventListener("click", run);
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (e) { if (e[0].isIntersecting) { io.disconnect(); run(); } }, { threshold: .35 });
    io.observe(box);
  } else { run(); }
})();
</script>

<script>
    function closePopup() {
        const popupOverlay = document.getElementById('popupOverlay');
        popupOverlay.style.opacity = '0';
        popupOverlay.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            popupOverlay.style.display = 'none';
        }, 300);
    }

    document.getElementById('popupOverlay').addEventListener('click', function(event) {
        if (event.target === this) {
            closePopup();
        }
    });
</script>
